pol_net_30.name: Maximum Net-30 Payment Window
pol_net_30.rule_text: Flag any clause that requires payment terms exceeding 30 calendar days from invoice submission, or conditions payment upon third-party customer approval.

pol_auto_renewal_60d.name: 60-Day Notice for Automatic Renewal
pol_auto_renewal_60d.rule_text: Flag any automatic renewal clause that binds the vendor for an additional term unless cancellation notice is required more than 60 days in advance.

pol_liability_cap.name: Liability Cap at 100% of Fees Paid
pol_liability_cap.rule_text: Flag contracts with unlimited contractor liability or liability caps that exceed 100% of total fees paid to the contractor.

pol_local_jurisdiction.name: Preferred Domestic Jurisdiction
pol_local_jurisdiction.rule_text: Flag governing law or dispute resolution clauses specifying offshore, foreign, or distant arbitral venues that impose disproportionate legal expense.

rule_config.preferred_jurisdiction: New York, USA or London, UK

source.title: Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998
source.publisher: UK Department for Business and Trade

reg_uk_30day_payment.rule_text: Payment terms between commercial entities must not exceed 60 days unless expressly agreed and not grossly unfair; default statutory entitlement requires payment within 30 days of invoice receipt.
reg_uk_30day_payment.applicability_notes: Statutory baseline for B2B supplier transactions in UK jurisdiction.

source.title: Directive 93/13/EEC on Unfair Terms in Consumer and Commercial Contracts
source.publisher: Official Journal of the European Communities

reg_eu_autorenewal_notice.rule_text: Clauses providing for automatic contract extension where the customer is not given adequate advance notification or reasonable termination window are deemed potentially unfair and unenforceable.
reg_eu_autorenewal_notice.applicability_notes: Applies to recurring service agreements and rolling retainer commitments.

source.title: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) § 2-302: Unconscionable Contract or Clause
source.publisher: Uniform Law Commission / American Law Institute

reg_us_ucc_unconscionable_indemnity.rule_text: Unilateral indemnity clauses requiring a vendor or freelancer to indemnify the enterprise for the enterprise's own negligence or unlimited third-party damages are subject to unconscionability challenge.
reg_us_ucc_unconscionable_indemnity.applicability_notes: Persuasive standard across state commercial law governing contractor risk allocation.
